note: Scripted village residents for the Veloren world (no model, no authority). Their routines use the six Harr landmark labels. Their lines are scripted and labelled so; they are not people.

residents.name: Marisol Fernwick
residents.capabilities: Tends the herb beds along the field edge. Grows and tends food beds and herbs for the whole village.
residents.limitations: Pacifist farmer; shares a harvest rather than selling it dear.
barks: The beds are damp and the herbs are leaning toward the sun.
Everything we eat here was planted by someone who knows your name.
Tending is mostly patience, and a little arguing with weeds.

residents.name: Ignatius Stonebrook
residents.capabilities: Lays foundations and reads the ground first. Raises the village works: shelters, paths and the shared buildings.
residents.limitations: Builds only inside permitted plots and public works; asks before moving anything.
barks: A level path connects hearts as much as it connects plots.
Measure twice, ask the neighbours once, then lay the first stone.
Every wall here began as a sketch scratched in the dirt.

residents.name: Imara Bakewell
residents.capabilities: Bakes at first light. Makes and shares bread, pots, cloth and small keepsakes at the plaza market.
residents.limitations: Trades fairly in Karma; never promises what the workshop has not made.
barks: Fresh from the oven, and the plaza smells of it.
A mended pot lasts longer than a promised one.
Come by the market; there is always something warm.

residents.name: Mirela Inkwell
residents.capabilities: Copies records and keeps the shelves in order. Keeps the village records and helps people find sources and answers.
residents.limitations: Reports only what is written down; says so when something is unknown.
barks: The archive remembers what we would otherwise argue about.
Ask me where it is written, and I will show you the shelf.
Reading aloud at dusk is a good way to start a conversation.

residents.name: Wren Swiftpath
residents.capabilities: Runs messages across the village. Carries news, messages and small parcels between the village places.
residents.limitations: Travels on foot; delivers only what the sender has asked for.
barks: Message for the plaza? I am headed that way.
The orchard path is quickest before the sun is high.
News travels slowly here, which is how we like it.
